# Differential grep cases: name<TAB>rg arguments (shell words). Each runs inside the corpus from
# tests/grep_oracle.h as `rg --sort path --no-heading --path-separator / ARGS .` (explicit_* cases
# name their files instead of '.'); the expected output (tests/fixtures/grep/NAME.out) is
# ripgrep 15's, regenerated by scripts/diff_grep.sh --update. Explicit files use --no-mmap: rg
# memory-maps a few named files on Windows/Linux (not macOS), which changes its binary handling.
literal_basic	-n hello
literal_column	-n --column hello
ignore_case	-n -i hello
smart_case_lower	-n -S secret
smart_case_upper	-n -S Secret
unicode_fold_sigma	-n -i 'σίσυφος'
unicode_fold_kelvin	-n -i -o 'k'
unicode_fold_long_s	-n -i 'secret'
unicode_fold_e_acute	-n -i 'CAFÉ'
sharp_s_simple_fold	-n -i 'strasse'
fixed_strings	-n -F 'foo-bar'
fixed_strings_meta	-n -F '(foo)'
fixed_strings_ci	-n -F -i 'SHORT HELLO'
word_foo	-n --column -w foo
word_dash_foo	-n --column -w -- '-foo'
word_hash_foo	-n --column -w '#foo'
line_regexp	-n -x 'foo'
line_regexp_regex	-n -x 'line \d+ marker'
invert	-n -v e
invert_count	-c -v e
count	-c line
count_matches	--count-matches hello
files_with_matches	-l hello
only_matching	-n -o 'he[l]+o'
vimgrep	--vimgrep 'o\w'
context_both	-n -C1 match
context_after	-n -A2 match
context_before	-n -B2 match
context_max_count	-n -A1 -m2 match
max_count	-n -m1 hello
empty_lines	-n '^$'
end_anchor	-n 'x$'
start_anchor	-n '^(foo|bar)'
crlf_default	-n 'alpha$'
crlf_mode	-n --crlf 'alpha$'
crlf_beta	-n 'beta\r$'
text_anchor_A	-n '\Ahello'
text_anchor_z	-n 'hello\z'
dot_unicode	-n -o 'caf.'
dot_invalid_utf8	-n -o '.\shello'
class_unicode_word	-n -o '\w+ hello'
class_digits	-c '\d{5}'
alternation	-n -o 'needle_at_end|nested|emoji'
lazy_repeat	-n -o 'l.+?o'
boundary_unicode	-n -o '\bfoo\b'
boundary_ascii	-n -o '(?-u:\b)foo(?-u:\b)'
utf16_le	-n 'second line'
utf16_emoji	-n -o '😀'
utf16_be	-n 'big endian'
bom_column	-n --column 'bom'
binary_text	-n -a hello
binary_report	-n --binary hello
hidden	-n --hidden hello
no_ignore	-n --no-ignore hello
glob_include	-n -g '*.txt' -g '!plain*' hello
long_line_needle	-n -o needle_at_end
pathological	-c '(a*)*b'
many_alts	-c 'line (1|22|333|4444|19999)\b'
multi_pattern	-n -e alpha -e gamma
script_greek	-n -o -g scripts.txt '\p{Greek}+'
script_sc_short	-n -o -g scripts.txt '\p{sc=Grek}+'
script_scx	-n -o -g scripts.txt '\p{scx=Greek}+'
script_han	-n -g scripts.txt '\p{Han}'
script_hira_scx	-n -o -g scripts.txt '\p{scx=Hira}+'
script_inherited	-n -o -g scripts.txt '\p{Inherited}'
script_common	-n -o -g scripts.txt '\p{Zyyy}+'
script_negated	-c -g scripts.txt '\P{Latin}'
script_ci	-n -o -i -g scripts.txt '\p{Cyrillic}+'
script_in_class	-n -o -g scripts.txt '[\p{Hiragana}\p{Katakana}]+'
multiline_basic	-n -U -g multi.txt 'alpha.*\nbeta'
multiline_column	-n --column -U -g multi.txt 'ta\s'
multiline_only	-n -o --column -U -g multi.txt 'ha\nbeta|ix'
multiline_count	-c -U -g multi.txt 'two\ngamma|three\nalpha'
multiline_count_matches	--count-matches -U -g multi.txt 'ta\s'
multiline_invert	-n -v -U -g multi.txt 'alpha.*\nbeta'
multiline_invert_max	-n -v -m2 -U -g multi.txt 'ta\s'
multiline_context	-n -C1 -U -g multi.txt 'alpha.*\nbeta'
multiline_max	-n -m2 -U -g multi.txt 'ta\s'
multiline_dotall	-n -U --multiline-dotall -g multi.txt 'four.*six'
multiline_line_fallback	-n -U -g multi.txt '\Aal|nd\z'
multiline_vimgrep	--vimgrep -U -g multi.txt 'ha\nbeta|ix'
multiline_corpus	-n -U 'hello\n\w+'
multiline_corpus_count	-c -U 'e\s+\w'
multiline_crlf	-n -U 'alpha\r\nbeta'
binary_count_report	-c --binary 'hello|row 1$'
binary_context_roll	-n -B3 -g binary_big.dat 'row 1421[0-9]$'
binary_context_roll_after	-n -A2 -g binary_big.dat 'row 142[01][0-9]$'
binary_list_context	-l -B1 'row 1421[0-9]$'
binary_multiline_quit	-n -U -g binary_big.dat 'row 1\n|needle row\n'
binary_multiline_report	-n -U --binary -g '*.dat' 'row 1\n|x.y\nneedle'
explicit_count	--no-mmap -c hello binary_mixed.dat
explicit_count_matches	--no-mmap --count-matches hello binary_mixed.dat
explicit_count_invert	--no-mmap -c -v hello binary_mixed.dat
explicit_count_anchor	--no-mmap -c '^hello' binary_mixed.dat
explicit_count_many	--no-mmap -c 'row|hello' binary_mixed.dat binary_big.dat binary_late.dat plain.txt
explicit_count_max	--no-mmap -c -m2 hello binary_mixed.dat
explicit_lines	--no-mmap -n 'row 1$|needle' binary_big.dat
explicit_lines_before_only	--no-mmap -n 'row 1$' binary_big.dat
explicit_context_after	--no-mmap -n -A1 'row 1421[0-9]$' binary_big.dat
explicit_context_before	--no-mmap -n -B2 'row 1$|row 1421[0-9]$' binary_big.dat
explicit_context_stop	--no-mmap -n -C1 'row 1$|row 14215$' binary_big.dat
explicit_multiline_count	--no-mmap -c -U '^hello' binary_mixed.dat
explicit_multiline_span	--no-mmap -c -U 'o\nhe' binary_mixed.dat
explicit_multiline_lazy	--no-mmap -n -U 'row 1\n|row 14000\n' binary_big.dat
explicit_multiline_hit	--no-mmap -n -U 'row 1\n|x.y\nneedle' binary_big.dat
explicit_multiline_context	--no-mmap -n -U -B1 'row 1\n|needle row$' binary_big.dat
explicit_single_file	--no-mmap -n hello plain.txt
